description: A line comment after a type constructor call in a JSON string is ignored
notes: The README reads the string as a native syntax expression, where a line comment counts as a newline, and doesn't say whether an expression in a string may be followed by one. hashicorp/hcl reads a call with hcl.ExprCall (getType in ext/typeexpr/get_type.go), which for a JSON string parses its content with hclsyntax.ParseExpression (expression.ExprCall in json/structure.go), whose scanner makes # c a comment token that the peeker drops (nextToken in hclsyntax/peeker.go).
